pf.license.need: if a trauma or crime scene cleanup registration, a regulated waste hauling permit (or a licensed hauler), or a drug lab cleanup certificate where the state requires it; else a business registration on file; nothing is looked up
pf.license.ask: each registration or permit number and the state it's from; the waste hauler's permit (the business's own, or its contracted hauler's)
pf.license.holds: the business; each technician's training is a staff check (pf.staff)
pf.license.checked: the state's lookup; a person on Rosie's team within 1 business day when it's down
pf.license.blocks: no drug lab cleanup without the certificate where the state requires one; no regulated waste hauled without a permit (a licensed hauler instead); a lapse stops new bookings for that work
pf.license.insurance: general liability and pollution liability where the state's form asks; workers' comp for crews
pf.license.renewals: expiry dates from the lookup; reminded before they lapse

pf.services.name: Trauma and crime scene cleanup
pf.services.price: priced at the visit (hours per technician, materials, waste disposal)
pf.services.timing: sent now, or booked once the scene is released
pf.services.money: nothing before; the bill after, or the insurer billed first when the customer assigns the claim

pf.services.name: Unattended death cleanup
pf.services.timing: sent now, or booked once released
pf.services.money: nothing before; the bill after (insurance often pays)

pf.services.name: Hoarding cleanup
pf.services.price: quoted from photos or a video walk-through
pf.services.money: a deposit to book the crew; the rest on the bill after

pf.services.name: Sharps and needle removal
pf.services.price: the example shop's own list price: $250 a visit

pf.services.name: Vehicle biohazard cleaning (flow A)
pf.services.place: the shop (the car is brought or towed in)

before_times: what happened, in plain words, asked gently (an injury, a death, a hoarded home, needles)
for a death or a crime: has the police or the medical examiner released the place
is anyone who died still there
who has the right to the property: the owner, the estate or next of kin, or the landlord or manager
about how big the affected area is (rooms, floors)
is an insurance claim being filed
after_time: how the crew gets in (key, lockbox, or who lets them in), on the secure page
is the water and power on
items to set aside and keep (photos, papers, valuables)
secure_page_only: the cause of death and any illness
the police report or case number
the insurance claim number and policy details
pf.questions.who_may_book: an adult with the right to the property: the owner, the estate's representative or next of kin, or the landlord or property manager; a hoarding cleanup for an adult who lives there needs that adult's own yes, or a guardian's papers; never a minor

stop_words: someone is hurt or not breathing
the person who died is still there
the place is still taped off by police
a strong chemical smell or a drug lab
pf.safety.tell_customer: Someone hurt, or the person who died still there: call 911 now. Taped off: the crew can't go in until the police or medical examiner release it; we book after. A chemical smell or a drug lab: leave and call 911. Please don't clean blood or fluids yourself, and keep people and pets out of that area.
pf.safety.continue: yes, once the place is released and nobody is in danger
pf.safety.on_the_job: crews wear protective gear and close off the area; regulated waste goes in marked containers to a licensed facility; a surprise finding (drugs, a weapon, more remains) stops work and the police are called

pf.first_steps.step: the place released by the police or the medical examiner (a death or a crime)
pf.first_steps.who: the customer confirms; the crew checks at the door

pf.first_steps.step: a work authorization signed by the person with the right to the property (and the insurance assignment, where they assign the claim)
pf.first_steps.timing: before work starts, on the secure page
before the cleanup days are booked

pf.first_steps.note: don't clean or throw anything out in the affected area; pets out; for hoarding, the resident names what to keep

pf.visit.check_in: the code from whoever lets the crew in; nobody needs to be there when a key or lockbox is given (DONE with photos)
pf.visit.work_changes: more contamination found under floors or in walls (removal needed), extra rooms, a dumpster: priced first, the customer's yes (the insurer's adjuster may need to OK it too)
pf.visit.proof: DONE with before and after photos kept on the secure page, the waste disposal record, and a clearance test report where the business does one
pf.visit.multiday: hoarding and decomposition jobs run several days; the crew lead texts each day's end
pf.visit.results: a clearance test (surface swab) report a day or two after, by a link

pf.money.defaults: scenes: nothing before, priced at the visit, the bill after; the insurer billed first when the customer assigns the claim (their share after); hoarding: a deposit to book the crew, the rest after; sharps: the bill after
pf.money.fees: no late-cancel or no-show fee (sensitive work); the owner may set one for hoarding jobs
pf.money.victim_funds: a crime victim fund may pay: the customer applies; the business bills whoever the customer names
pf.money.rosfield_fee: $2 per confirmed booking (not a health practice or a law firm)

pf.messages.never_in_text: what happened, the service's name (biohazard, trauma, death, hoarding), the cause of death, any illness, the police report or claim number, photos
pf.messages.texts_say: the business's plain display name, the date and the time only
pf.messages.owner_staff: initials, the address and 'a cleanup' only
pf.messages.tone: gentle words; no sales, no rating

pf.staff.training: each technician: bloodborne pathogen training each year and a respirator fit test (a staff check, kept on file)
pf.staff.crew: at least 2 on a death or crime scene; a crew lead on each job
pf.staff.stand_in: any trained crew may stand in; a family who named a person is called first (nobody moves on silence)
pf.staff.who_oks: the crew lead OKs changes up to the owner's limit; the owner above it

pf.rules.waste: regulated waste to a licensed facility with a disposal record for each job, where the state requires
pf.rules.release: work starts only after the place is released
pf.rules.authorization: a signed work authorization before work
pf.rules.cancel_period: work sold at the customer's place: the written cancel period where the state's form gives one (switch cancelright); where the state's form allows, a customer facing an emergency may waive it in writing
pf.rules.records: disposal records and photos kept 7 years, on the secure page

pf.edges.not_released: the time waits until the release; booked after
pf.edges.someone_else_owns: the person with the right to the property gives their own yes on a forwarded link
pf.edges.insurance_denies: the customer pays the bill as agreed
pf.edges.resident_says_stop: a hoarding resident says stop: the crew stops; the booker hears only that it stopped
pf.edges.surprise_finding: drugs, a weapon or more remains: stop, police
pf.edges.someone_asks: neighbors, media or a landlord who didn't book: nothing is shared
